lines.text: Hazael king of Aram captured Gath, so Joash sent him sacred objects and bronze from the temple and palace.
Joash's servants killed him at Beth-millo, and his son Hezekiah reigned in his place.

problems.problem: Its wrong detail "Gath" is in 2 Kings 12:17, so it isn't wrong.
The line also says the true detail "Gath".
Its wrong detail "Amaziah" is in 2 Kings 12:21, so it isn't wrong.
The line also says the true detail "Amaziah".
